en.headline: Hong Kong ranks 14th in global property transparency index
en.dek: JLL's biennial survey placed the city third in Asia behind Japan and Singapore, with a composite score of 1.97 in the Transparent tier.
body: Hong Kong ranked 14th in the 2026 Global Real Estate Transparency Index compiled by property consultancy JLL and LaSalle Investment Management, remaining in the Transparent tier with a composite score of 1.97, according to JLL's local briefing.

The biennial index covers 146 city markets across 88 countries and territories and scores them from 1 to 5, with 1.00 the most transparent. Japan placed 12th and Singapore 13th, putting both in the Highly Transparent group of 13 markets headed by the United Kingdom. Hong Kong was the next Asian market on the list.

JLL Greater China co-chief executive Alex Barnes said the ranking showed a mature and resilient property market. He said reliable market information, a clear regulatory setting and technology-driven data would matter more to investor confidence as global buyers grew more cautious.

JLL said about two-thirds of markets improved over the past two years, with Asia-Pacific accounting for half of the ten largest gainers, led by India. Transaction volumes in the world's most transparent markets rose 64 percent over the same period, the firm said.

zh.headline: 仲量聯行：香港地產透明度全球第14 亞洲第三
zh.dek: 2026年全球地產透明度指數顯示香港綜合評分1.97，維持「具透明度」級別，亞洲僅次於日本及新加坡。
body: 仲量聯行與LaSalle Investment Management發表第14份《全球地產透明度指數》，香港以綜合評分1.97分位列全球第14，繼續屬「具透明度」級別。
指數每兩年公布一次，涵蓋88個國家及地區共146個城市市場，以1至5分評級，1分最透明。日本及新加坡分別排第12及第13位，同屬全球13個「高透明度」市場；香港是亞洲下一個上榜市場。
仲量聯行大中華區聯席行政總裁鮑雅歷表示，排名反映香港地產市場制度成熟且具飼性。他說，隨著全球投資者更審慎，可靠的市場資訊、清晰的監管環境及科技驅動的數據，對維持信心及吸引資金更形重要。
仲量聯行指，過去兩年全球約三分之二市場透明度有所提升，亞太區佔十大進步市場一半，當中印度升幅最大。該行又指，全球最透明市場的成交額同期上升64%。
